title: Estimates of $Γ$-functions and their $\log{}$-derivatives
summary: We provide a lower bound for a weighted ratio of $Γ-$functions and its $\log{}-$derivative. Then we apply this result to estimate the norm of the operator associated with the Cesáro operator in the Hardy space $H^p({\mathbb C}_+)$, $1<p<\infty$
